info.name: American TEST API - Full Dashboard and Student Flow
info.description: Full Postman collection for the EST preparation platform. Run folders in order. Assumes a staff/superuser exists for dashboard signin; defaults are admin/AdminPass123 but can be changed in collection variables. OTP verification endpoints are included; for local manual testing, paste the OTP into signup_otp_code/password_reset_otp_code before verification requests.
